label: session-close command
detail: New llmos_toolkit plugin: session-close runs rag-index (kernel/projects/reference) -> rag-handoff (writes state/SESSION_HANDOFF.md) -> git commit, in one call. Closes the staleness gap named in the handoff doc (index/handoff previously only updated when manually invoked). Reuses existing handoff_rag cmd_index/cmd_handoff rather than reimplementing.

label: session-close drift-log step
detail: session-close now runs drift-log against every kernel/*.md file as step 3 of 4 (re-index, handoff, drift-log, commit). Recalibrates mechanical drift detection automatically every session close instead of requiring manual invocation. All 5 kernel files freshly baselined this run.

label: ledger-compact command
detail: New command: llmos ledger-compact <file> --keep N. Rolls raw jsonl entries beyond the keep threshold (default 20) into one permanent skeleton_summary entry (event counts, date range, labels touched) and keeps the N most recent raw entries in full. Idempotent -- an existing skeleton is never re-summarized, only raw entries are. Tested on a scratch copy of growth_ledger.jsonl before any real use: 7 old + 3 recent -> 1 skeleton + 3 recent, re-run confirmed no double-compaction.

label: session-close step 5: automatic ledger compaction
detail: session-close now runs ledger-compact automatically as step 5 of 5, on growth_ledger.jsonl/drift_audit.jsonl/token_ledger.jsonl (default keep=20 raw entries each). --no-compact skips it; --compact-keep N overrides the threshold. Manual llmos ledger-compact <file> --keep N remains available standalone, unaffected. Compaction commits separately from the main session-close commit so the two stay distinguishable in history. Tested end-to-end with a forced low threshold (--compact-keep 5) on the real growth_ledger.jsonl before confirming the sane default (20) correctly no-ops on current ledger sizes.
